adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, the function parses a minimal schema that does not require `refresh_token`, then forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` if missing. Call sites then use this parsed data as updated credentials (e.g., Office365 merges `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials`, and Zoom likely stores `parsedToken.data`), which can overwrite a real stored refresh token with the placeholder, effectively losing the actual refresh token and breaking future refresh flows if the sync endpoint is disabled/removed or code paths expect a real token.
